parameters.formDescription:
Upload a clear selfie and we'll turn you into anime stickers!
- One clear, front-facing selfie — good lighting, no sunglasses or heavy shadows
- Face the camera directly (not a side angle or tilted head selfie)
- Solo photo works best — no group shots
Wearing glasses, a hat, or facial piercings? They'll be included — just know results can be a little less predictable around those spots.

values.formSubmittedText: You're all set! 🎉 Your stickers are being prepared and will land in your inbox in a few minutes.
